additional_info.subject: New ID is created for this unit
RE: ID0430148/DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / S5 170003620]Charger Out Of Order. CRM:02681000287
additional_info.body:
Hi Daniel & Nenad,
Thank you for your cooperation during the intervention.
Summary of the Intervention:
We attempted to perform CFast flashing with firmware version v6.0.3, but unfortunately, it resulted in the creation of a new charger ID. We repeated the process several times and verified the Live Linux files; however, each attempt continued to generate a new ID.
As a result, we proceeded to configure the newly generated ID on the SCB. After completing the configuration and updating the router settings, the charger became healthy and operational.
The new ID for this charger is: "nfeVUo".
There are 8 open cases related to this charger. We are proceeding to close those cases accordingly which are opened for the similar issue and this case will be handing over to the RC queue for documentation purposes. Kindly attach the FSR and close this case in the RC queue as well.
The following cases will be closed, as they are related to the same issue mentioned above:
ID0425853-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP/S5 170003620] Faulted Plugs
ID0429629-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP/S5 170003620] Charger Offline
0429693
Also, as requested, the
old CFast card
needs to be sent to the
R&D team
for further investigation.
Best Regards,
Sominath Nagalgaon
eMobility Support Team
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.
Need to follow up with Sambath regarding the CFast card tomorrow, and then hand over the case to the RC queue for documentation.

additional_info.subject: Status update 09.07.2025
additional_info.body:
From
R&D Ticket :
EVC3-9619:
Analysis shows that 2 sectors of the cfast card got corrupted. Unfortunately the kernel was also stored on those two sectors.
The Bad Sector Management on the cfast card already swapped the bad sectors with spare sectors which makes the cfast card still functioning, but the information on the bad sectors is lost.
Due to the Bad Sector Management the CFast card looks ok

additional_info.subject: 0430148 - ID0430148/DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / S5 170003620] Charger Out Of Order. CRM:00314000199
additional_info.body:
Dear Nenad and Daniel,
I am reaching regarding this ticket
ID0430148
as I received it from Sambath. I was informed that the issue onsite was solved, and that the CFast card was sent to R&D for further analysis.
The feedback from R&D is that 2
sectors of the CFast card got corrupted. Unfortunately the kernel was also stored on those two sectors.
The Bad Sector Management on the CFast card already swapped the bad sectors with spare sectors which makes the CFast card still functioning, but the information on the bad sectors is lost.
As there is no further pending action from service side, and the feedback from R&D has been provided, I will proceed to close this ticket.
If you need any further assistance, please do reach back out to us by submitting a new request at
